cards.title: Why it works
items: The launch contract lives in the row: pins carry run content, tune slots carry a domain and a stamped default
The door refuses every missing binding before any write — a bad launch writes no state and spawns no model
Depth ladder: a `where` seam keeps the audit lane out of the concrete graph while the knob sits low
Verb family: a `by` patch swaps the work goal per case — branching by binding, not by agent discretion

cards.title: Contract
items: {{echoes}} echo, {{agents}} agents, {{edges}} edges: guard brief, then the bound verb's work node, audit only at full depth
params — pin: session; tune: verb (watch|act) and depth (brief|full), effective bindings stamped into the run record
